# FIMA Lab

Finance ∙ Intelligence ∙ Math ∙ Analytics

Welcome to FIMA Lab. Founded by Prof. Huei-Wen Teng in 2010 and now based at National Yang Ming Chiao Tung University, Taiwan, we bring together statistics, machine learning, financial engineering, and FinTech to turn data into practical, evidence-based answers. We publish with collaborators around the world, mentor students, and work with industry on real problems. Researchers, students, and companies are all welcome. Get in touch at [hwteng@nycu.edu.tw](mailto:hwteng@nycu.edu.tw).

Our research spans four pillars, and lab members collaborate across them.

### 1. **Explainable AI & FinTech** — machine learning for credit scoring and default prediction

Credit-scoring and default-prediction models that keep machine-learning accuracy while staying transparent enough for banks and regulators.

### 2. **Trading & Portfolio Management** — empirical asset pricing with machine learning

Forecasting stock returns, earnings and Bitcoin volatility from market data and text, and building portfolios on those forecasts.

### 3. **Financial Market Risk Management** — tail risk and digital asset regulation

Tail risk, Value-at-Risk and expected shortfall for Basel capital, and the regulation of digital assets.

### 4. **Financial Derivatives Pricing** — Monte Carlo simulation and cryptocurrency options

Monte Carlo methods for pricing and hedging options, including cryptocurrency options.

📚 Our publications: [Publications](https://venteng.github.io/Publication.html)

## Interested in Joining? Let’s Make an Impact Together!

1. Enrolling in my *Machine Learning & FinTech* course is a great way to build relevant skills for our research — it’s highly recommended.
2. **MUST** attend weekly lab meeting on Wednesday afternoon. 
3. If you are from a different department, we encourage you to review the suggested [course plan](https://imf.nycu.edu.tw/imf/ch/app/artwebsite/view?module=artwebsite&id=5997&serno=b1153a31-aa1c-46a2-8205-b611f9cffa7c) to help build a solid foundation in finance.
4. Email me! ✉️ [hwteng@nycu.edu.tw](mailto:hwteng@nycu.edu.tw)
